fullDescription: Warm luxury editorial style dashboard featuring a midnight and rose gold color scheme. Utilizes high-end serif typography (Boska) paired with a clean Swiss sans-serif (Switzer). The layout is characterized by editorial spacing, 3D tilt interactions, glassmorphism panels, and layered radial glows. Suitable for premium NFT marketplaces, high-end fintech platforms, luxury brand portfolios, and sophisticated SaaS dashboards requiring a 'dark mode' aesthetic with warm, organic lighting.

structured.summary: A sophisticated, editorial-inspired dashboard titled 'Warm Luxury' that combines a deep midnight background with cream and amber accents. The design features a central interactive glassmorphism table with 3D tilt effects, elegant typography, and a subtle grain texture for a vintage photographic feel.

style.description: The style is 'Editorial Luxury'. It uses a dark base (#07060a) with warm, cream-colored text (#f6f0e7) and muted gold highlights (#cbbfae). Typography pairs the high-contrast serif 'Boska' for headlines with the functional 'Switzer' sans-serif for UI elements. Visual depth is achieved through layered radial gradients (amber/rose), a subtle svg-based grain overlay (9% opacity), and deterministic star-like dots in the background. Interactive elements include a 3D perspective tilt on the main container and staggered fade-in animations for data rows.
style.prompt: Create a luxury editorial style UI. Colors: Background #07060a; Text #f6f0e7; Muted text #cbbfae/60%; Accent amber rgba(180,83,9,0.28). Typography: Headlines in 'Boska' (serif, font-weight: 600, tracking-tight), UI/Body in 'Switzer' (sans-serif, tracking-widest for caps). Effects: Apply a 0.09 opacity grain overlay with 'mix-blend-soft-light'. Background must feature a large top radial wash (1200px wide) of amber/gold light. Use glassmorphism for containers: 'bg-black/55 backdrop-blur-xl border-white/10'. Shadows should be soft and deep: 'shadow-[0_30px_120px_rgba(0,0,0,0.58)]'. Animations: Staggered row entry using cubic-bezier or ease-out, translating 20px upwards while fading in.

layout_and_structure.description: Centered editorial layout with a focused data panel. The page is structured with a minimalist header, a central typographic hero, and a large-format interactive table as the centerpiece.

prompts.prompt: Minimalist navigation bar. Left: Brand name in Switzer, 12px, tracking-[0.32em]. Center: Three nav links (Explore, Portal, Community) in 14px Switzer at 60% opacity. Right: Two circular buttons (40x40px) with 1px border and subtle black/30% background—one for a theme toggle and one for 'Connect Wallet' (rounded-full).

Vertical stack with high breathing room. Top: A capsule badge 'New: AI integration' (border-white/10, bg-black/25, rounded-full). Middle: 60px Boska serif headline 'Top Collections'. Bottom: 16px Switzer subtext at 55% opacity, max-width 2xl. Entire section is center-aligned.

A 3D-tilting container (rounded-3xl, border-white/10). Internal layout: Grid-based table with 12 columns. Header row: 11px uppercase tracking-widest text. Body: Rows separated by thin 1px white/10 borders. Each row features a 50x50px thumbnail with rounded-lg corners and a conic-gradient glow. Hover state: 'bg-white/5 transition-colors'. The container sits on a complex 'mid-layer glow' consisting of amber and pink radial gradients that create a halo effect behind the panel.

special_ui_components.description: The main data container reacts to mouse movements with a smooth 3D rotation.
special_ui_components.prompt: Implement a JS-driven 3D tilt effect on the main dashboard panel. Use 'perspective(920px)' on the container. Map mouse coordinates (X, Y) to a rotation range of -3.6 to +3.6 degrees. Apply a 'transformStyle: preserve-3d' and use a RequestAnimationFrame loop for high-performance smoothing (0.12 interpolation). The card should have a top-edge highlight ('h-px bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-[#f6f0e7]/15 to-transparent') to enhance the 3D feel.

special_ui_components.description: Small, high-detail status indicators used within table rows.
special_ui_components.prompt: Create 'Curated' or 'Utility' badges: 10px uppercase Switzer text, tracking-widest, inside a rounded-full border (white/10) with a subtle white/5 background wash. Pair with 16px sky-blue icons ('lucide:badge-check') for verified statuses.

special_ui_components.description: Image placeholders that use gradients to simulate luxury lighting.
special_ui_components.prompt: Thumbnail placeholders (50x50px) using 'conic-gradient(from 180deg, rgba(251,191,36,0.65), rgba(244,114,182,0.25), rgba(180,83,9,0.55))' or 'linear-gradient' to represent NFT art. Apply 'ring-1 ring-white/10' and a deep colored shadow matching the dominant gradient color.
